usage: app {--help | --version} <command> [<args>]...

  -h, --help     Display this help screen then exit
      --version  Print the build version then exit

Sub-commands:

  init     Initialize the workspace
  help, h  Display help for a command
  version  Print the build version then exit


Additional help topics:

  credentials  Providing usernames and passwords
  everyday     A useful minimum set of commands for everyday use
  faq          Frequently asked questions about using the app
  glossary     A glossary of terminology
  migration    How to migrate from other tools
  namespaces   How to use namespaces
  tutorial     A tutorial for new users
  workflows    An overview of recommended workflows with the app
